title: Authorization receipt (publication-bound)
description: A content-addressed receipt binding one decision to one candidate AND to one exact publication: the operation, the target, and the hash of the exact bytes. The binding is part of the record before receiptId is computed, so one signature over receiptId expresses: I authorize publishing these exact bytes, via this operation, to this target. Still not a signature by itself: the detached signature is a separate artifact.

notASignature.description: Carried in the document itself so a reader cannot mistake the receipt for a cryptographic signature. The signature, when one exists, is the separate signatures/<receiptId>.sig.json artifact.

operation.description: The two supported operations. pr-create is retired: its result cannot be fully bound under the current contract (the proposed commits and target branch would sit outside the signature).

targetNumber.description: The issue or pull request being commented on. Null for the operations that create their target, whose number does not exist yet.

bodySha256.description: Digest of the normalized body: BOM stripped, line endings folded to LF, trailing newlines dropped.

titleSha256.description: Required (non-null) for issue-create, which publishes a title; null for issue-comment. The cross-field rule is enforced in code (lib/authorization.mjs), because this validator carries no conditionals.

dependsOn.description: Lineages that must have published (a recorded attempt with outcome published and detail.bodyIdentical true) before this one may. Additive: a 1.1.0 receipt written before the field existed carries none and is read as []. Existence, openness, self-reference, duplicates and cycles are refused by the store at authorization; satisfaction is re-checked at gate-publish, reserve-attempt and by the publisher.
